title: 植物雕塑
prompt: The [subject] appears as if organically grown from intertwining plants, flowers, and vines. Leaf-like textures and blooming forms fuse seamlessly with anatomical or structural details, creating a surreal hybrid of nature and design. The composition feels ethereal, with natural asymmetry and dreamlike flow.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创作出植物与结构融合的超现实雕塑作品，适合艺术装置、生态时尚或奇幻媒体中的自然灵感设计，带来空灵流动的视觉体验。
